title: Righteousness of God
definition: The righteousness of God means that God is perfectly right in all His character, judgments, commands, and works.
summary: God always does what is right and is the standard of righteousness.
christFocus: Jesus reveals God's righteousness and provides righteousness for sinners through faith.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God is righteous in Himself and in all His ways. His standards are not borrowed from outside Himself; He is the measure of what is right.

God's righteousness includes His justice, faithfulness, purity, and truth. He judges rightly and saves rightly. At the cross, God shows that He is both just and the justifier of the one who has faith in Jesus.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: People often define right and wrong by preference, culture, or benefit. The righteousness of God matters because it gives a holy standard above human opinion.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek God's righteousness rather than self-justification. Trust Christ for righteousness before God, and pursue righteous conduct in daily life.
